scope: runtime modules only; no Pi Web host installation

local_patches.summary: readModels refreshes the provider catalog once when the first answer is empty or an error (carried from upstream pull request 9)
Lock regenerated for those overrides, so six package versions differ from the base: MCP SDK 1.32.2, body-parser 1.20.9 and 2.4.0, fast-uri 3.1.9, markdown-it 14.3.3 and qs 6.16.1.

Dependency overrides raised (MCP SDK 1.31.0 to 1.32.2, markdown-it 14.3.1 to 14.3.3) and new overrides added for body-parser 1.x and 2.x and fast-uri 3.1.9, with dependencies reformatted onto separate lines.

Added file: usingAcceptanceWorkspace creates one workspace for an acceptance run, archives it afterwards and confirms it left the project's workspace list, recording the outcome as workspaceCleanup on the result row.
withLock takes an optional helper and passes it on to withLockTransition so a caller can select the hash-pinned Python flock helper.

providerReplyError also classifies billing, insufficient-credit and payment-required replies as PROVIDER_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED, and the new providerTurnError maps a failed turn to a fixed error code without keeping its message.
Added file: safeChatResult wraps chatResult so a failed, timed-out or permission-blocked provider turn returns only a fixed status or code, never the provider's partial reply or error text.
withLockTransition can run a hash-pinned Python flock helper (the helper option or PI_PASEO_FLOCK_HELPER, sha256 f178c22c...) through /usr/bin/python3 instead of util-linux flock.
